checks.check: In-memory chmod removal mutation under root
checks.result: Expected regression detected: new directory 0700 instead of 0755; unsafe-parent test still passes; no source mutations.

review_findings: New directories are created only after recursively validating trusted root-owned ancestors, then validated before chmod and again afterward. Existing directory modes are preserved.

Production secure_path rejects symlink parents and group/world writable or special-bit directories. Unprivileged replacement races are excluded by trusted parent ownership/modes; concurrent malicious root mutations are outside this trust model.
Implementation retains process private umask 0077; no temporary process-global umask relaxation is introduced.
Root test uses production secure_path and a real uid/gid 65534 subprocess to read generated public configuration.
Existing STATE identity/SSH directory modes are preserved; runtime_guard is unchanged and remains before prepare mutations.
The shared helper also gives a newly created /run/a733-management directory mode 0755; its SSH configuration and lock remain 0600. No SSH key directory uses this creation path.
independent_review.limitations: Software review only. Existing live 0700 configuration directories are intentionally not repaired by this new-directory fix. Rebuild/deploy/reboot and real service-reader/listener verification remain coordinator-owned after workload evidence preservation.

software_repair.behavior: Explicitly set new public RAM directories to 0755 after trusted-path validation; inherited umask077 no longer removes read/search permissions. Existing directory modes are preserved.
software_repair.additional_scope: New /run/a733-management also becomes0755; its sshd_config and lock remain0600. Private host key stays in protected STATE.
software_repair.artifact_requirement: Rebuild managed A/B roots and update full installation artifacts; existing protected root images retain the bug. Preserve compatible external BOOT, firmware, kernel and DTB.
software_repair.physical_verification: After endurance retention and booting corrected roots, require readable resolver drop-in as systemd-resolve, global LLMNR/mDNS disabled, no TCP/UDP5355 wildcard listeners, ordinary DHCP/DNS/NTP and pinned SSH retained; verify exact SD zero-write counters.
